description: The high-frequency magnitude (m3Hz) of Italian earthquakes from intensity data – the ICEM Catalog is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Stefano Parolai et al. The assessment of seismic hazard and risk requires a catalogue of earthquakes (both historical and recorded during the instrumental era), where the location and magnitude of events affecting the study area are reported. Mw is commonly used for this aim, but it is a static measure of earthquake size and it cannot capture the full extent of earthquake source complexity. Coverage: national (IT); published in 2026. Formats: TXT, Image. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
